okoṭimaka.p: [(ava+koṭi+ma-) okoṭima+ka. ] (ti) Google Translate Ava Kotiyasati ဪ Kotimao. ဩ Kotimo Eve ဩ - What about Kotima? Abi ပု. Religion.] Wrinkled at the bottom. . Short he.

F: Okoṭimaka，（o + koṭi + mant + ka．Ava in BSk．，in formula durvarṇa durdarwana avakoṭimaka），矮小（lit．“having the top lowered”，with the head squashed in or down．）。SA．21．6．/II，236．︰Okoṭimakanti rassaṁ．（矮小︰矮短。）
P: Okoṭimaka，（adj．） [o + koṭi + mant + ka．Ava in BSk．，in formula durvarṇa durdarśana avakoṭimaka Sp．Av．Ś I．280．Kern （note on above passage） problematically refers it to Sk．avakūṭara = vairūpya （Pāṇini V．2，30）．The Commentary on S．I，237 explns． by mahodara （fat-bellied） as well as lakuṇṭaka （dwarf）； Pug．A 227 expls． by lakuṇṭaka only] lit．“having the top lowered”，with the head squashed in or down，i．e．of compressed & bulging out stature； misshapen，deformed，of ugly shape （Mrs．Rh．D．trsls hunchback at S．I，94，pot-bellied at S．I，237； Warren，Buddhism p．426 trsls． decrepit）．It occurs only in one stock phrase，viz．dubbaṇṇa dud-das（s）ika okoṭimaka “of bad complexion，of ugly appearance and dwarfed” at Vin．II，90 = S．I，94 = A．I，107 = II．85 = III，285 sq．= Pug．51．The same also at M．III，169； S．I，237； II，279； Ud．76．（Page 163）

ပုကွသော （ကုဏ္ဍက）။ ဝမ်းကြီးသော （မဟောဒရ）။
DOP: okoṭimaka mfn. [ BHS avakoṭimaka], dwarfish ; Vin II 90, 23 (ekacco dubbaṇṇo hoti duddasiko ~o bahvābādho) ≠ M III 169, 31 (Ps IV 213, 20 : ~o ti lakuṇṭako paviṭṭhagīvo mahodaro); S I 238, 15 (dubbaṇṇataro c’ eva °-taro ca); II 279, 18 (passatha … etaṃ bhikkhuṃ āgacchantaṃ dubbaṇṇaṃ duddasikaṃ ~aṃ yebhuyyena bhikkhūnaṃ paribhūtarūpan ti) ≠ Ud 76, 15 (Ud-a 369, 2 : ~an ti rassaṃ, iminā ārohasampattiyā abhāvaṃ dasseti).
CPD: okoṭimaka , m ( fn ) . [ cf. BHS avakoṭimaka and v. BHSD, s. v.; the derivation and meaning are uncertain; shortness and thickness of stature seem to be the basic meaning of the term ( v. infra )] , thick and dwarfish; — found usually in the stock phrase: dubbanno hoti duddassiko ~ o, Vin ll 90, 23 = M lll 169, 31 ( ~ o ti lakuṇṭako paviṭṭhagīvo mahodaro, Ps lV 213, 20 ) = S l 94, 2 ( ~ o ti lakuṇṭako, Spk l 163, 1 ; ~ o ti ārohābhāvena heṭṭhimakoṭiko rassakāyo ti attho, Spk-pṭ Be 1961 l 195, 1-2 ) = 237, 18 ( ~ o ti lakuṇṭako mahodaro, Spk l 354, 11-12 ; rassabhāvena avarakotimako, Spk-pt Be 1961 l 343, 2-3 ) = ll 279, 18 ( ~ aṃ rassaṃ, Spk ll 236, 17 ) = A l 107, 26 ( ~ o lakuṇṭako, Mp ll 176, 12 ) = ll 85, 19 = Ud 76, 15 ( ~ an ti rassaṃ; iminā ārohasampattiyā ca abhāvaṃ dasseti, Ud-a 369, 2 ) = Pp 51, 26 ( ~ o lakuṇṭako, Pp-a 227, 27 ); — Rem .: although Spk-pṭ seems to connect ~ with koṛi ( top, summit; v. DEDR 2049) there is little reason to believe that this derivation is correct; if ~ is of Dravidian origin it is more likely to be connected with the group given at DEDR 1670, but v. CDlAL 3238 and 3260 which would seem to suggest a connection with the group given at DEDR 1688; cf. la-kuṇṭ-aka; sa. √khuṇḍ.
